key_family_door: Ovary superior and commonly 3-carpellate/3-locular with one ovule per locule.
Fruit commonly a dry 3-part capsule/schizocarp whose cocci separate from a persistent central columella.
Latex, stipules, glands, and distinctive hairs are useful supporting clues but are not universal.

genus_pattern_priority.cue: stellate/lepidote trichomes; often pistillate below staminate flowers
stinging hairs; latex absent; small flowers
stinging hairs + white latex + palmately lobed leaves
basal pistillate + upper staminate spike; persistent gynobase

lookalike_families.split: one ovule per locule favors Euphorbiaceae; Phyllanthaceae typically two; latex/glands also more supportive of Euphorbiaceae
latex overlap; fused corolla and 2-carpel gynoecium favor Apocynaceae vs reduced unisexual flowers and usually 3-part fruit in Euphorbiaceae
stinging hairs overlap; Euphorbiaceae confirmation comes from the unisexual reproductive plan and superior usually 3-part ovary/capsule
